name: blindsanitize
oneliner: Checks a paper's source, PDF and supplementary files for anything that gives away its authors before a double-blind submission, and hands back cleaned copies.
fact: A test submission with 61 planted identity strings came back with none left in the source or the PDF's hidden data. The 5 left are in code files, which it flags for you instead of editing.
note: A pattern-based scan, not a guarantee. The optional build check downloads about 177 MB the first time.

name: maketitle
oneliner: Opens an arXiv paper's LaTeX source in an editor and compiles it in your browser tab.
fact: Edit the title of paper 1706.03762, press Ctrl+Enter, and a new PDF is on screen in 4.76 seconds with TeX Live cached.
note: The first visit downloads about 21 MB of TeX Live. Of 33 well-known arXiv papers tried, 28 built on the first try. After one compile it works offline.

name: papershed
oneliner: Cleans a LaTeX zip before you post it: strips comments, photo GPS and PDF metadata, and flags possible leaks.
fact: Its own planted sample zip went from 4.6 MB to 1.3 MB. It flagged 9 possible leaks and removed 14 files and 9 comments.
note: The optional compile check downloads about 177 MB the first time.

name: texdiet
oneliner: Finds what makes a LaTeX project slow to compile and hands back a smaller zip.
fact: A public 30.1 MB test thesis zip came back as 7.7 MB with 10 changes listed. Nothing was deleted and nothing was uploaded.
